g.title: AXIS3
g.text: AXIS 3 — AGE IS STRONGER THAN POTENCY
=> ~80% of lifetime HO is laid down before age 25.
Same 57% efficacy prevents 52% of lifetime HO if
started at 8, but only 10% if started at 25.

g.title: AXIS4
g.text: AXIS 4 — EFFICACY AND TOXICITY SHARE ONE AXIS
The growth plate IS endochondral chondrogenesis.
60% HO suppression came with PPC in 36.8% of
No dose separates them while physes are open;
only skeletal maturity does. But that is exactly
when the remaining benefit has fallen to ~10%.

g.title: AXIS1
g.text: 0.90 flares/pt-yr x 26.9% that ossify x 28.8 mL
A drug that abolishes 100% of flare-ups removes
at most ~30% of new heterotopic bone.
Corroborated: 47% report progression with no flare;
59% of new adult lesions are not at a flare site.
